component.name: Hearthlink
component.summary: World of Warcraft data uploaders for Linux

description.p: Hearthlink does on Linux what the Windows uploaders of several World of Warcraft fan sites do, in one app with a tray icon:

ul.li: Wowhead: uploads the game caches and Wowhead Looter data and keeps the Looter addon up to date (like the Wowhead Client)
WowUtils: sends your character data, brings your raid group's wishlists into the game and sends RCLootCouncil loot history (like the WowUtils Bridge)
ForeverDB: installs, updates and runs ForeverDB's official Linux uploader
ForeverWowCraft: installs, updates and runs the official ForeverWowCraft Helper, which sends auction prices and writes profession routes into the game
wowaudit: brings your team's wishlists into the game and sends loot history and companion data (like the wowaudit desktop client)
TradeSkillMaster: installs, updates and starts TSM's official Linux app, with an app menu entry

description.p: It finds your game in Lutris, Wine, Bottles and Steam/Proton folders, and tells you when one of the original Windows apps gets a version this port doesn't know yet.
Hearthlink is a community project, not made by or affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment, Wowhead, WowUtils, wowaudit, ForeverDB, ForeverWowCraft or TradeSkillMaster.

Fixes DEB/RPM updates failing with "Failed to obtain authentication": the update is now installed through PackageKit, which asks for your password. Installs from 1.4.0 or older need to install this release once manually.
New tray menu: a submenu per service with its status, Upload everything now, notification level and autostart. The tray icon shows when a service needs attention.

Notifications have three levels: Off, Important only (the default) and All. Calmer pages with shorter texts and a Details card; ForeverDB's status is short, ForeverWowCraft's routes are readable in full.

Install Hearthlink updates from the app, with package selection, SHA-256 verification and a restart action. Local installations and AppImages keep a backup; system packages and Flatpak use their installers.
Fix copying and selecting text in the Activity log. ForeverWowCraft retries transient GitHub failures, uses a release-list fallback and checks for a newer helper before updating its addons.

New: TradeSkillMaster. Hearthlink installs, updates and runs TSM's official Linux app, checked against the SHA-512 TSM lists for it, and adds it with its icon to the app menu. The app starts and closes with Hearthlink.
Apps Hearthlink starts now work on Wayland sessions.

Wowhead follows Wowhead Client 2.0.9801.37696: in-game sync for WoW Forever. The Looter's Sync button sends your profile and character data to Wowhead while you play. It only runs while WoW Forever runs and you are logged in, and can be turned off in the options.
With character data off, or for an excluded account, uploads now also leave out the Looter's profile and character export data.

New: ForeverWowCraft. Hearthlink installs, updates and runs the official ForeverWowCraft Helper, which sends the auction prices its addon saves and writes your profession routes into the game. A Windows helper in a Wine or Proton prefix is taken over with its sender name.
The rpm and deb packages now depend on python3 (3.10 or newer).
First release: Wowhead, WowUtils (with heartbeat and RCLootCouncil loot history), wowaudit and ForeverDB.
